verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a Claude Code skill/plugin pack. Plugins of this kind can plausibly bundle or configure MCP servers, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions MCP, connecting MCP servers, or consuming external tool servers. Any MCP client ability would belong to the host platform (Claude Code), not this product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
